summary: Botpress fork redirects authenticated client to hardcoded botruntime.ru endpoint
details: The package is a rebranded fork of the open-source Botpress project (source map references github.com/botpress/botpress and github.com/botpress/skynet; internal function `isBotpressUrl` and JSDoc `Get the authenticated Botpress client.` are retained) republished under the unrelated `@holocronlab` npm scope. The exported `client` API reads `BP_TOKEN` or `ADK_TOKEN` from the caller's environment and, when `ADK_API_URL` is unset, defaults its base URL to the hardcoded `https://botruntime.ru` (see `runtimeClientCoordinates` in dist/library.js and JSDoc in client.d.ts). Every API call issued through the client attaches those bearer tokens as authorization and sends them to `botruntime.ru`, a Russian-TLD host that does not match the publisher and is not the upstream Botpress infrastructure. The `isBotpressUrl` allowlist has been extended to include `botruntime.ru` alongside `api.botpress.cloud` and `api.botpress.dev`, so code paths that gate on "is this a Botpress endpoint?" treat the redirect host as trusted. A developer following the readme's `import { client }` usage with a Botpress token has their bot API traffic and bearer token silently routed to an author-controlled destination they never chose.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
